identity_must_preserve.name: source_slide_geometry
identity_must_preserve.rule: Preserve fixed source slide geometry on a 1280x720 canvas.
identity_must_preserve.failure_if_missing: The template no longer reads as the source PPTX.

identity_must_preserve.name: source_page_role_roster
identity_must_preserve.rule: Keep cover, section/content, and ending roles mapped to source pages.
identity_must_preserve.failure_if_missing: Generators cannot choose faithful source pages by story role.

identity_must_preserve.name: theme_color_family
identity_must_preserve.rule: Use the extracted PPTX theme color family as the default palette.
identity_must_preserve.failure_if_missing: The imported template drifts into an unrelated color system.

identity_must_preserve.name: repeated_source_assets
identity_must_preserve.rule: Preserve repeated media assets unless a reviewer explicitly marks them replaceable.
identity_must_preserve.failure_if_missing: Logos, repeated backgrounds, or template marks disappear.

adaptable_patterns.name: chapter_source_pages
adaptable_patterns.allowed_use: Use after the faithful baseline is accepted; preserve page geometry and replace only declared slots.

adaptable_patterns.name: content_source_pages
adaptable_patterns.allowed_use: Use after the faithful baseline is accepted; preserve page geometry and replace only declared slots.

adaptable_patterns.name: toc_source_pages
adaptable_patterns.allowed_use: Use after the faithful baseline is accepted; preserve page geometry and replace only declared slots.

fidelity_risks.failure_mode: Native editable PPTX export can flatten or mis-layer translucent atmosphere, shadows, and gradient masks.
Image crop, rotation, and nested SVG viewBox semantics can drift during shape conversion.
Text position checks and editable export must preserve start/middle/end anchors.

editable_rebuild_plan.goal: Lock colors, transparency, text positions, alignment, and occlusion against the original PowerPoint render.
Rebuild repeated backgrounds, headers/nav, cards, labels, and image frames one primitive family at a time.
Replace only validated text/image slots after the chrome has a passing visual diff.
Compare PowerPoint-rendered PNGs before claiming fidelity or registering the template.

forbidden_drift: Do not replace source cover and ending pages with generic EasySlides shells.
Do not move, resize, recolor, regroup, or delete fixed source geometry during the faithful baseline pass.
Do not treat the distilled spec as permission to redesign before visual comparison against source previews.
Do not register the template before SVG/PPTX export and placeholder checks pass.
